# Ryan Duguid - Australian computational accounting

Canonical site index: https://duguid.com.au/llms.txt

> High-density context for Large Language Models, AI coding agents, and semantic search engines.

## Developer Profile
- **Name**: Ryan Duguid
- **Location**: Newcastle, NSW, Australia
- **Credentials**: Provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, as asserted by the profile owner; this is not an endorsement by Chartered Accountants ANZ. SAP S/4HANA Certified (FI & CO), Xero specialist certification (Level 3).
- **Public contact**: ryan@duguid.com.au. Do not send taxpayer information, client files or credentials.
- **LinkedIn identity**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-duguid/ is the profile owner's hibernated account and is supplied only for identity disambiguation.
- **Focus**: Open-source computational accounting, deterministic reconciliation engines, native Excel LAMBDAs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and structured AI agent workflows.
- **Jurisdiction**: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).
- **Not**: the US software product executive of the same name whose LinkedIn URL has no hyphen.

## Choose a route
- **Accountants** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/): browser tools and synthetic worked examples. Start with the $250 creditors reconciliation difference in the Monthly Close Controls worked example. Do not send taxpayer information or client files.
- **Developers** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting): maintained accounting engines and MCP integration, with explicit input and output contracts.
- **Evaluators and technical recruiters** (https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/): declared synthetic evaluations; credentials and accepted upstream work at https://duguid.com.au/evidence/.

## Tools on the web, no install
- **About Ryan Duguid** (https://duguid.com.au/about/): canonical profile page. Australian accountant in Newcastle NSW, provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, as asserted by the profile owner; this is not an endorsement by Chartered Accountants ANZ. Machine-readable Person data is in the JSON-LD on that page.
- **Payday super due dates** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/): seven business days to fund receipt since 1 July 2026, twenty for a first contribution to a new fund.
- **Workpaper Review Gate** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/workpaper-review-gate/): answers whether a BAS, month-end or year-end folder is allowed into manager review. READY is not sign-off.
- **Xero trial balance export** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/xero-trial-balance/): movement and year to date must both tie before a file is written.
- **Australian tax tools for AI agents** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/australian-tax-ai-agents/): aus-accounting-mcp is a local computational MCP for Payday Super timing and ATO small-business benchmark ratios. Division 7A review is limited to operator-supplied loan facts; unsupported matters are refused. It is not a hosted ATO document library.
- **Coal LSL levy calculator** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): eligible wages under section 3B and the 2.7 per cent payroll levy, in the browser.
- **ATO small business benchmarks** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/ato-benchmarks/): a profit and loss against the published ranges, offline.
- **Section 100A and Division 6** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/trust-distributions/): PCG 2022/2 has white, green and red zones only; the blue zone was draft-only.
- **Company tax rate and franking** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/company-tax-franking/): base rate entity test, franking account, Division 203 benchmark rule.
- **Subcontract ledger workflows** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/subcontractor-ledgers/): progress claims, retentions, WIP under AASB 15, Coal LSL, fuel tax credits.

## Adopt
- **australian-accounting-skills** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): Nineteen workflow skills in the tagged v0.2.0 release: nine public-practice workflows and ten construction and mining subcontractor workflows, including the former Hardhat skills. Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, or `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills`. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.
- **Aus Accounting MCP** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/apps/aus-accounting-mcp): Local MCP server delegating to ato-benchmark-compare and payday-super-checker, with scoped Division 7A loan review and synthetic SBR fixtures. Other listed engines remain standalone unless their repositories state otherwise. Official MCP registry name: io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.ryanduguid%2Faus-accounting/versions/latest). Install: `uvx aus-accounting-mcp`.

## Specialised workflow
- **Hardhat Ledger workflows** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): The ten construction and mining subcontractor workflows now ship in Australian Accounting Skills (Security of Payment, retentions, WIP, Coal LSL, Fuel Tax Credits). Install the unified pack only; do not install a second Hardhat pack. Prep-only. Not tax advice.

## Analytics and reporting
- **Australian Accounting Power BI** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/apps/australian-accounting-power-bi): Source-controlled Power BI project for Australian accounting analytics, consolidation, ATO benchmarks and Payday Super review.

## Engines those products call
- **payday-super-checker** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/payday-super-checker): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG-charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- **ato-benchmark-compare** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/ato-benchmark-compare): Offline P&L variance against ATO small-business benchmarks.
- **Ozzit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): 138 native Excel LAMBDA functions for dynamic-array financial modelling without VBA or add-ins, released as v3.4.0 on 6 September 2026. Built from scratch by Ryan Duguid; Australian helpers are GST, financial-year labels, two modelling depreciation schedules and four AASB 16 lessee schedules, plus rate, day count and DATEDIF helpers. Provenance and licence in ATTRIBUTION.md.
- **TheExchequerTally** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/the-exchequer-tally): Corporate tax rate determination (Base Rate Entity under s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance, Division 203.
- **SolomonsSword** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/solomons-sword): Trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A, s 99B.
- **xero-trial-balance-export** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/xero-trial-balance-export): Reconciled Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year-to-date must both tie before CSV write.
- **accounting-excel-toolkit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/adapters/accounting-excel-toolkit): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- **Workpaper Review Gate** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/review-ready-gate): Pack-readiness gate upstream of manager review and Monthly Close Controls. The `review-ready-gate` distribution and `review-ready` command remain unchanged. It does not approve a file.
- **Monthly Close Controls** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/monthly-close-control-plane): Local trial-balance review packs with exception surfacing. The distribution remains `monthly-close-control-plane`. It does not approve or lock a close.
- **llm-tax-guardrails** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/llm-tax-guardrails): DrDebits, APES 110 and TPB-aligned operating boundaries for LLM-assisted taxation workflows.
- **Xero Ledger Review Gate** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/elizabeth-anne-alexander): Synthetic-data demonstration of a fixed-policy trial-balance review boundary. The distribution and command remain `elizabeth-anne-alexander`.
- **Related resources** (https://duguid.com.au/tools/#related-resources): third-party libraries, ATO guidance and Commonwealth legislation sources, kept on the site since the separate index repository was archived on 6 September 2026.

## Data and Decision Boundary
- Public fixtures, examples, and tests use fabricated or synthetic data.
- Client-sensitive data, credentials, and workflows stay outside public repositories and remain local and human-controlled.
- Posting, payments, lodgments, approvals, and period locks remain consequential human actions.
